status: Nineteen source marks restored after companion-scan inspection and independent root corroboration; forty-seven disclosures retained
method: Fresh embedded native-image inspection covered all66 remaining primary-row source notes. Corresponding primary and independent companion crops were compared for every accepted correction. Nearest-neighbor integer enlargement only; no OCR, smoothing, sharpening, synthetic reconstruction, grammatical completion or consonant changes. Each new mark required independent root corroboration before canonical editing. Earlier review reports are unchanged.
